requests.name: 寒冰剑
requests.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Rough repaint of 寒冰剑 preserving the ORIGINAL layout.
EDIT IMAGE 1 ONLY. Image1 is this card's ORIGINAL production illustration and is the authority for composition and prop identity. Images2/3 provide broad opaque anime paint handling ONLY. Preserve image1's exact aspect ratio, object position/scale, camera, primary silhouette, object count, major motif placement and background color. Do NOT redesign, zoom, change angle, mirror the object, add unrelated props or replace the original concept. Repaint in a ROUGH HAND-PAINTED COLOR STUDY style with LARGE opaque blunt directional strokes, connected color masses, one broad grouped shadow and a few broad midtone dabs per region. Coarse irregular handmade edges, sparse selected structural sketch accents, quiet painted interiors. Reduce tiny engraved details and texture while retaining major shape identity. Roughness is fewer WIDER purposeful marks, not grain, canvas filters, dense scratches, little triangular chips or all-over noisy texture. Matte surfaces, mostly hard grouped values, no glossy 3D, polished photoreal material, bloom or cinematic lighting. Background should retain its original color and empty layout as flat SOLID color, eliminating gradients/texture where unnecessary. No new words, watermark, UI or border; only retain original dial/suit symbols where the specific design requests them. 
COMPOSITION LOCK: Same long icy sword diagonal: TIP at LOWER LEFT, HILT at UPPER RIGHT (DO NOT reverse direction). Same full blade length/width, thin blue grip and blue pommel at top-right crop, BLUE central guard gemstone and ice-wing crossguard spikes around it. Same pale cyan plain background with ample empty space. Group numerous tiny frost spines into a handful of large icy wing shapes, long blade in broad white/icy-blue planes, no extra floating shards or changed sword guard.
